## Known biases

Williams: the full text was not readable (Wiley returns HTTP 403 to automated clients and no open copy was found), so its numbers are unchecked; it is a New Zealand expert-elicitation study. Bor et al. is a preprint (manuscript submitted to Earth&\#x27;s Future), not peer reviewed, and Table 1 gives HV (&gt;345 kV, anchored) substations only; the flood parameters are taken from a literature synthesis (Kabre and Weimar 2022). Karagiannakis was read on an arXiv copy of the article, not the publisher page.
